items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: My, yeah. I know Lizzie well.

ctx.x: I know her. She worked at Tomath with me, too. She was with you, too. Yeah, she worked at... She lived at Covington. She lived about 30 miles from there.
I met her once when Lizzie Miles was working on Bergen Street. She came by to hear Lizzie. She used to be a friend of her.

Friend of Liz. I'm a Lizzie girl. Her name was Lizzie Pazio, for you. Oh, yeah. She still uses that name. My, yeah. I know Lizzie well. Your honey Wilhelmina was well-friendly. Her name is now Wilhelmina Durone.
